name: agentic-artifact-builder
description: Local validation scripts for the static, framework-free Agentic Artifact Builder app. No dependencies, no build step, no install required.

scripts.check:syntax: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const {execSync}=require('child_process');function collect(dir,ext){return fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>{const p=path.join(dir,e.name);return e.isDirectory()?collect(p,ext):(e.name.endsWith(ext)?[p]:[]);});}const files=[...collect('src','.js'),...collect('tests','.test.mjs'),...collect('examples','.js')].sort();for(const f of files){console.log('node --check '+f);execSync('node --check '+JSON.stringify(f),{stdio:'inherit'});}"
scripts.test: npm run test:catalog-integrity && npm run test:renderer-smoke && npm run test:filename-convention && npm run test:example-fixtures
scripts.validate: npm run check:syntax && npm run test
